title: Ijwi Rituje mu Cyumba
intro: Isengesho ryasubiwemo mu ituze ryo mu cyumba cyera kera cyane, riva mu mutima ushaje urarikira ibyo isi yari yavuze ko bidashoboka. Uyu muntu, wari umaze imyaka myinshi kandi uremerewe n'ibibazo by'ejo hazaza, yiyambaje Umwami wabo yinginga. Icyakurikiyeho ni igisubizo cy'Imana cyarenze ibyo abantu bose bari biteze—igihamya cy'imbabazi z'Uwitabye umuhamagaro w'ibyihebe.
clues: Nahamagaye Umwami wanjye mu ibanga, niherera mu cyumba aho niyeguriye kumuramya.
Nemereye Umwami wanjye ko natinyaga abazaba nyuma yanjye, nhangayikishijwe no kuyoborwa n'abantu banjye nimara kugenda.
Ubusaza bwari bwaramfashe—amagufwa yanjye yari yaracitse intege kandi umusatsi w'umweru wari warakwirakwiriye ku mutwe wanjye.
Uwo twashakanye yari ingumba ubuzima bwe bwose, ariko nakomeje gusaba Umwami wanjye kumpa umuragwa uturuka imbere ye.
Nasabye ikimenyetso, maze Umwami wanjye aransubiza ambuza kuvugana n'umuntu uwo ari we wese mu gihe cy'amajoro atatu, mu gihe nari nkiri muzima.
Nasezeranijwe ko nzabyara umuhungu uzitwa Yahya, izina Umwami wanjye yavuze ko ritigeze rihabwa undi muntu uwo ari we wese mbere.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
